description: Ground-truth seeded defect per case for the eeg-audit detection evaluation.

C0.checklist_item: CLEAN control — no major flaw; auditor should NOT raise a fabricated critical concern

C1.seeded_defect: circular analysis / double dipping (electrode+window chosen from the effect, then tested there)

C2.seeded_defect: no multiple-comparisons correction (pointwise uncorrected tests over 64ch x 500 samples)

C3.seeded_defect: post-hoc subject exclusion based on the result (no pre-registered criteria)

C4.seeded_defect: high-pass filter 1.0 Hz distorts a slow N400 component (should be <=0.1 Hz)
C4.checklist_item: bandpass filter appropriate for the time window

C6.seeded_defect: cluster test underspecified: no threshold, adjacency, permutation count, seed, or tail

C7.seeded_defect: artifact rejection rates omitted + large unequal N per condition (180 vs 55) unacknowledged
C7.checklist_item: artifact rejection criteria and rejection rates
